author: willai3213
title: Looking for graphic designer / character visual design for exhibition
content: 【徵｜展覽平面設計專案合作 】近期正在籌備一場預計於 12月初在台北華山 舉辦的展覽，想尋找一位有興趣合作的平面設計師，一起完成這次展覽的視覺設計！ Includes character visual design (6 styles), standees, etc. Interested designers please comment or DM with portfolio + quote.
